message: Hi, does the AI chatbot support multiple languages?
Yes! Chatty AI supports multiple languages, you can configure them in Settings > Language.
How do I set up a referral program?
You can set up referral under Loyalty > Programs > Referral, I can guide you step by step.
My widget disappeared after the last update, please help urgently.
I'm escalating this to our technical team, will update you within 30 minutes.
Can customers share their wishlist via link?
Yes, each wishlist has a shareable link, found under Wishlist > Share.
I want a refund, the AI gave wrong answers to my customers.
I'm sorry to hear that, let me review the conversations and get back to you with a resolution.
